title: Green Hills Cottage
description:
Relax with the whole family at this peaceful 3 bed/2 bath home.  Located in the Green Hills neighborhood of Nashville.  The cottage is less than one mile from Nashville's 12 South neighborhood, 4 miles from downtown, 3 miles from Vanderbilt University, 2 miles from Belmont University, and blocks from Lipscomb University.

The space
Our home is in a quiet neighborhood in Green Hills and has 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms.  

The master bedroom (king bed) and master bathroom are on the second floor (stairs), along with laundry (washer and dryer), and sitting room/library. 

The first floor includes a primary living room upon entering, a "sunroom" with 43" television and seating for 6, a dining room, kitchen, outdoor porch off kitchen, bathroom, and two bedrooms (one with a queen bed and twin bed and another with two twin beds).

Parking for 4 vehicles (2 on the street and 2 in the parking pad off the street).  Both parking areas require steps down to walk to the front door of the house.

Guest access
Guests have access to the first and second floors.  Guests will not have access to the basement garage.
